decisions.reason: A startup accelerator is peripheral to the firm's core machinery business and could be cut to free resources, but it costs little to keep and supports its partnership-driven brand.
The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship of the firm's new direction, though it sits far from its core plastic and oil recycling technology and faces long market adoption cycles.
The infectious waste plant is a flagship developed with the partner ERMAFA, is close to the core WASTX offer, and serves a clear regulated demand.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the core modular WASTX line, can be used as a pretreatment stage, and fits the firm's decentralized strategy directly.
